name: Glacier Meditation
summary:
Glacier Meditation takes you to six places in Glacier National Park, filmed on location in 360 degrees and shaped into immersive 3D scenes you can sit inside.

Choose how you want to spend your time:

Guided: three guided meditations (Gratitude, Kindness and Light), each in a 3, 6 or 12 minute version, 36 minutes in all. A calm voice leads you while the place sounds around you.

Natural: just the place. Sit by the water and let the sound of the park carry you, for as long as you like.

Chimes: a row of poli
